issuance.text: Cohere issues API keys from its dashboard in two entitlements: a free evaluation (trial) key and a paid production key. The two differ by entitlement, not by shape, so one family covers both.
The SDK reads the key from CO_API_KEY (documented) and also accepts COHERE_API_KEY; it is sent as an Authorization: Bearer header.
Keys are created on the dashboard's API keys page, key names cannot contain spaces, a key is shown once, and it can be revoked in the web UI or the CLI.
